messages:
Alex: FYI pushed a small hotfix PR that adds the status page links + fixes the SDK streaming snippet. Need reviewers and to merge during tomorrow's docs merge window (10:00-11:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 Maria: Thanks — added to the queue. CI/docs preview is failing for me though: preview build 422. @CI-bot can you drop the failure log? :eyes: CI-bot: build #412-preview failed — markdownlint: MD047/fenced-code-language — code fence language 'python' requires a blank line before the fence. Thomas: I can pick up the review once CI is green. Also note the SDK streaming snippet should use `StreamingClient.stream()` from v2, not the legacy `stream()` call. Alex: good catch, pushed a fix to the snippet and added an explicit heading id to make the anchor stable (`

Streaming SDK

`). Re-requesting preview. Maria: pushed a small editorial change too (clarified rate-limit wording). I also added a Known Issues section with the workaround from the outage: "If you see intermittent 503s after a rollout, retry with exponential backoff (start 200ms) and fall back to the compatible `redwood-small` model." Jen: I'll be the merge owner during the window tomorrow. Two merge checks for me: 1) preview shows the status page link works and anchors survive the build, 2) CI passes with no lint errors. I'll post 5 min warning in #release-war-room. Thomas: Preview is up: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-412 — the status page link resolves but the `#sdk-streaming` anchor was stripped in one renderer. Suggest making the heading explicit with the id attribute (already done?) and adding an in-page link: `[SDK streaming](#sdk-streaming)`. Alex: I updated the heading id and added the explicit in-page link. Also included the status page URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1420 in the Known Issues section. CI-bot: preview succeeded for PR 412 — snapshot ts=2026-03-18T14:22:00Z; markdownlint ok, link-check ok, preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-412/snapshot-20260318 Jen: Great. I'll merge at 10:05 PT tomorrow (within the window). Alex — please squash the small editorial commit so history is tidy. Alex: Squashed and force-pushed. All green. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup: Maria: Added a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md labeled `hotfix/docs` per our process. Thomas: Quick follow-up: after merge, can someone watch the docs redirect logs for broken anchors for the next hour? I can watch from 10:00–11:00 PT. Jen: I'll coordinate with eng-oncall to keep an eye on traffic. If anything weird shows up we'll roll back the change and post to #incidents. Alex: Noted. Closing the loop here — PR merged during the window. Will post a short item in the incident postmortem linking the docs hotfix.
